name: better-render
description: Formulas as images and aligned CJK tables in Claude Code's replies, rendered by the pi-better-render core (display only; replies, transcripts and the model's context keep the original Markdown).

images.title: Formula images
images.description: auto: images in Ghostty and kitty, readable text elsewhere. on: always try images. off: always text.

cellAspect.title: Cell height / width
cellAspect.description: Your terminal font's cell height divided by its width. Formula pictures are drawn for this shape; raise it if formulas look squashed, lower it if they look stretched.

formulaColor.title: Formula color
formulaColor.description: A #rrggbb color for formulas. Empty: white or black by Claude's theme.
